summary: Regencell Bioscience Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K on May 8, 2026, furnishing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the six months ended December 31, 2025. The filing includes a press release announcing first-half 2026 management financial results and exhibits with financial statements and XBRL data. It is a routine earnings report for a foreign private issuer, incorporated by reference into an existing F-3 registration statement. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is disclosed. This is a standard periodic financial update with no transactional or strategic catalysts.
